note: Superior National Forest (Gunflint district) rustic campground beside the Cascade River where Forest Road 158 crosses it, inland from Lutsen and Grand Marais; popular with trout and salmon anglers. No tables at the sites and no garbage pickup: pack out all waste. Sites are pull-ins not designed for RVs, and only one of the four is longer than 21 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 4 sites, free, vault toilet, no water, season May 8-Oct 1, no reservations. Not waterfront kept (creekside possible but no site numbers to place). Not coastal walk (about 13 km inland). Phone missing.
flags: CRITERIA (fit, unchanged caveat): the FS page says 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Only one of the four sites is longer than 21 feet and may accommodate an RV.' No length for that one site is given. Kept with the caveat in the note per the unclear-fit rule.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept. The sites are small clearings on the west side of FR 158 at the bridge (around 47.8324,-90.5300); the Cascade River there is about 20-25 m wide on zoom-19 imagery (creekside class, not riverfront), and the clearings sit about 12-30 m from the bank with scattered conifers between. Without a site map the four sites can't be numbered, so no upgrade; a reviewer may consider creekside. COASTAL WALK: no - the campground is about 13 km inland from Lake Superior (FS directions: 15 miles up the Caribou Trail from Lutsen, then FR 170 and FR 158).
PHONE missing: FS page gives the Gunflint Ranger District, (218) 387-1750. Suggest 218-387-1750.
Pin 47.83225,-90.52982 is about 5 m from the FS point (47.8320653,-90.52973846) at the clearings; no move. Website confirmed.
